displayName: AsterPay — EUR Settlement & Agent Trust API
description:
EUR settlement layer for AI agents. Convert USDC/EURC to EUR via SEPA Instant.

**Free tools (no payment required):**
- `check_agent_trust` — KYA trust score 0-100 for any Ethereum wallet
- `get_trust_tier` — Trust tier classification (open/verified/trusted/enterprise)
- `get_settlement_estimate` — Calculate EUR amount for USDC conversion
- `discover_services` — List all available AsterPay API endpoints

**Protocols:** x402, A2A, ERC-8004
**Chains:** Base, Ethereum, Solana, XRPL, Polygon, BNB Chain
**Docs:** https://asterpay.io/docs

tools.name: check_agent_trust
tools.description: Check KYA trust score (0-100) for any Ethereum wallet address. Returns trust score, tier, sanctions status, and identity verification. Free — no payment required.

tools.name: get_trust_tier
tools.description: Get trust tier classification for a wallet. Returns: unknown, basic, verified, trusted, or enterprise. Free.

tools.name: get_settlement_estimate
tools.description: Calculate how much EUR you get for a given USDC amount via SEPA Instant. Returns net EUR, fees, exchange rate, and estimated settlement time. Free.

tools.name: discover_services
tools.description: List all available AsterPay API endpoints with pricing and descriptions. Free.
